headline: 500条双臂家务遥操作数据开放下载
title_en: SE3 Labs open-sources 500 bimanual teleop demos in LeRobot format
tagline_en: 500 real dual-arm demos across 10 household tasks, 6.3 hours, ready to load in LeRobot.
summary_md:
SE3 Labs has published `real-robodojo-teleop-500` on Hugging Face: 500 successful teleoperation episodes (about 6.3 hours) covering 10 real-world bimanual manipulation tasks from their RoboDojo benchmark, 50 episodes per task. Tasks range from packing objects into a box and hanging mugs to plugging in a charger and inserting tubes.

Why it matters: bimanual data from real hardware is still scarce and expensive to collect, and this set follows the LeRobot dataset format (v3.0), so it loads with the standard tooling instead of a custom loader. Everything is recorded on one station — two 6-DoF YAM arms with parallel grippers and three RealSense D405 stereo cameras (top-down, left wrist, right wrist) — at 30 fps, with 14-dim state/action vectors (12 joints + 2 grippers). Full-rate ~500 Hz arm logs are included as raw parquet files, and camera intrinsics live in `meta/cameras.json`. It is licensed CC-BY-4.0.

Can you try it without a robot? Yes, at least partially. The dataset page links LeRobot's browser visualizer, so you can scrub episodes on any machine. On a Mac you can pull the parquet metadata and train a small ACT or Diffusion Policy on a few episodes to practice the imitation-learning loop — you just can't evaluate on hardware.

Caveats: there is no accompanying paper, the README lists the homepage and paper as "More Information Needed," and all episodes are successes, so any policy evaluation will look rosier than reality.

top.title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
top.one_liner: 让多模态大模型当世界模型，单张图生成可反复重访、可编辑的持久世界
top.one_liner_en: Turns MLLMs into world models that keep a persistent, editable 3D world state from one image.
top.how_to_try: 依赖大型图像/视频生成模型，Mac 16GB 基本跑不动；只能看项目页 demo 视频，或读代码理解状态管理思路
top.how_to_try_en: Needs heavy image/video generators; a 16GB Mac can't run it. Watch the demo and read the code to grasp the state-tracking idea.
top.reason: 思路新颖：把世界状态外置成可编辑全景，解决重访漂移问题，概念值得讲；但无硬件几乎玩不了，来源存疑需先核实。
red_flags: arXiv 编号与日期疑似不实，无法核实真伪
未标注许可证，且无热度支撑，复现性存疑
生成式世界模型的图像质量与真实物理一致性未验证

top.how_to_try: 项目页有演示视频；想动手需在 Isaac Gym/MuJoCo 里跑，Mac 上只能看代码和视频，跑训练要云 GPU

top.reason: 系统研究地形-指标-速度如何共同决定最优步态，概念清晰、迁移亮眼；但需云 GPU 训练，新人只能看演示。
red_flags: 未标注许可证，代码可用性存疑

trend.name_en: World Action Models for Robot Policy Learning
trend.one_liner: 让机器人先学会预测动作会带来什么后果，再据此选出好动作来执行。
trend.one_liner_en: Models that learn how actions change the world, then use that prediction to choose and improve robot actions.

evidence.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
evidence.one_liner_en: A robot policy teaches itself actions by peeking at future video as a teacher.

evidence.title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
evidence.one_liner_en: Turns an arm robot model into a language-guided quadruped that manipulates with one front leg

evidence.title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
evidence.one_liner_en: Post-trains a humanoid whole-body VLA with RL inside a video world model instead of a simulator

evidence.title: WAMotor: Accelerating World Action Models via Speculative Inference under Dual Nonuniform Denoising Dynamics
evidence.one_liner_en: A speculative decoding method that speeds up world-action model denoising by 3-4x without hurting success rates.

evidence.title: bageldotcom/Bagel-Robotics-1
evidence.one_liner_en: A pruned, compact world-action model checkpoint for robot manipulation, released openly

evidence.title: PhysVAM: Physics-oriented Future Value Action Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
evidence.one_liner_en: Predicts future task value instead of future frames to help robots handle moving objects
